facts.fact: 夜行群口相声：Fragon 抱怨黑暗+被拖行玩笑；Draven 向全队复述客栈初遇（「我坐着等饭——她带着审讯的目的过来」+「我在她开口前就自首了——见过她把一个成年人放倒」）；Hellbore「People always underestimate her until they know her」；她的耳语感谢得到绳子三下回敲
facts.anchor: she came at me with a mind to interrogate.

facts.fact: Hellbore 揭史：十三岁的她是「skinny, wiry thing」、天天来、自愈血赋让他们赶不走——「最后只好当男人用」；参军牺牲论（Icarus：hot meals/shelter 换走家庭）；蜥蜴笑话（「She's not a fucking lizard, man」）
facts.anchor: They couldn’t get rid of her, so they finally treated her like one of the men.

facts.fact: Lux Stone 目击：湖边一队人举光过 Crooked Walk——疑 Ryger（Blackiston 驻过、有石头渠道）；决策：无光静行、错峰到 Wentor（「不想被尾随——他会拿我当夜间向导」）
facts.anchor: there’s a trail of men crossing the Crooked Walk

facts.fact: 崖边放绳：绳长不够（Draven 的马多一马身）——她放手信任他的听觉（「你的心跳？Jaco 的更好，它更大」）；50 英尺悬崖不报数；Shadow Vision 过载头痛；贸易线抵达
facts.anchor: I can hear your heart. Jaco’s is better, what with it being larger.

facts.fact: 土豆条事故：他递「肉」给她攥着安心——竟是 Guard 配给的干土豆条（肉是条状的）；comfort cat 呼应+捏屁股惩罚+「You have no idea」
冲刷路段：路面只剩三英尺、疑似人为破坏；她抢先过（「These are my men. And you are my liability. I will go first.」）——按体重排序渡河（Draven 最重先行）
facts.anchor: These are my men. And you are my liability.

facts.fact: Blight 危机：Mercy 后蹄打滑惊慌——她翻身徒步贴近、借 Blight 对马说话（「Trust her. Don't look down.」他偏往下看——Fuck）；Draven 手握绳待命（「haul them up the bank if they slipped further」——「Even the little one」）；马稳人归+「I won't make you [go last]」+Peltin 手语致谢
facts.anchor: She’s going to get you across. Trust her.
